title: Handley Page Halifax JD105 and F86 Sabre XD733
memorial_details: description: 1939 - 1945/ THIS PLAQUE IS A MEMORIAL TO THE AIRCREWS OF ALL ALLIED NATIONS WHO LOST THEIR LIVES IN THE SURROUNDING COUNTRYSIDE, NOT LEAST THE CREW OF HALIFAX BOMBER JD105, 10 SQUADRON MELBOURNE, WHICH CRASHED WITHIN HALF A MILE OF THIS SITE MAY 5TH 1943./ ALSO IN MEMORY OF THE PILOT OF F86 SABRE XD733 92 SQUADRON, LINTON ON OUSE, SEPTEMBER 21ST 1954
